source_note: National Crime Records Bureau, district-wise IPC crime statistics 2001–2014. Counts of cases recorded, not individuals. State totals reconcile with NCRB published rollups.
caveats: Counts of cases recorded by police, not individuals or amounts.
Telangana appears from 2014 onward; earlier years count its districts under Andhra Pradesh.
FORGERY is only reported in the 2014 schema.
State rollup rows are excluded; district sums reconcile with NCRB published totals.
